title: STP house is the newest Flowable directory entry and its own site fails basic verification
content:
STP house was added to the Flowable Partner Finder on 2026-08-14 and mined four days later, on 2026-08-18 — the newest entry in the sweep. Checking it produced a poor result: the site is inconsistent and the contact page 404s to a 2019 theme.

Directory freshness is not verification, and this row is the clearest demonstration of it. A partner card can be created the moment a commercial arrangement is signed, well before the firm has a maintained public presence to support it, and a contact page that fails while resolving to a six-year-old theme is evidence of a site nobody is tending. The listing therefore claims more currency than anything behind it.

That makes this the strongest argument in the sweep for treating the Partner Finder as a list of leads to verify rather than a qualified pipeline. The firm is excluded on geography in any case — it is based in Netanya, outside the EU scope — but the verification failure is the part that generalises to the other entries.
